title: Multilingual Hate Speech Detection and Counterspeech Generation: A Comprehensive Survey and Practical Guide

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing performance disparities between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource or code-mixed languages using quantitative metrics (like macro F1-score) in cross-lingual transfer, zero-shot learning, and translation-based models.

Analyzing subjective qualitative evaluations, measuring inter-annotator agreement divergences across geographic regions (e.g., USA vs. India), and utilizing human-in-the-loop experts to assess the contextual appropriateness of counterspeech.

Reviewing the application of fairness metrics such as FNED (False Negative Equality Difference) and FPED (False Positive Equality Difference) to quantify and mitigate model error rates across inferred or annotated demographic groups.
